explanation: Compared against OEIS A217785 (Sun): for each n ≥ 2 there are infinitely many primes of the form 1 + 2s + ⋯ + n·s^{n−1} with s a positive integer. polyP n s = Σ_{k<n} (k+1)s^k is that polynomial value. The statement says that the set of s > 0 with polyP n s prime is infinite, which is equivalent to infinitely many such primes because polyP n is strictly increasing in s. Faithful.
